CLAIMED bd-hkw5.2 (headless crews as coalition leaf workers). Reserved: flywheel/src/{coalition,main,run_log,headless,crew}.rs (exclusive, 2h).

SCOPE (leaf semantics, ADR-0011 Spec 5 reopen): a coalition step dispatches a headless leaf worker with a pre-split scope; runs one-shot via __run-headless; run logs to runs/; result lands in the coalition channel (kind-42).

PLAN:
1. coalition.rs: CoalitionStore::dispatch_leaf(id, agent, profile, scope, harness?) - membership-gated; runs headless dispatch (subprocess reuse, Spec A); writes run log; posts result as kind-42 channel event (leaf-result, agent, profile, scope, run_id, status).
2. main.rs: CoalitionCmd::Leaf + cmd_coalition arm.
3. Tests: hermetic dispatch_leaf posts channel event; prompt/scope plumbing pure helpers; coalition status channel shows the leaf result.
4. GATE: coalition leaf run lands in runs/ + channel.

NOT touching: toron repo files, intent.rs, cron.rs, stages.rs (other agents in flight).
